text: Place a lemon cut in half under your bed and do not tell anyone. What happens over the next few days may surprise you. This is an ancient practice that most people do not know about. The lemon is one of the most used fruits in ancestral traditions for absorbing heavy energy. It pulls toward itself what is dense in the environment, what is stuck, what is blocking your life while you sleep. Do this! Before bed, take a fresh lemon, cut it in half, and place both halves on a white plate under your bed at the height of your head. Do not tell anyone. Just sleep. The next morning, look at the lemon. If it is dark, dry, shriveled, as if it had aged overnight, the environment was heavy, the energy there was denser than you imagined. If it has strange spots or an overly strong smell, the buildup is old, days, weeks, maybe months of emotional weight stuck in the place where you rest. If the lemon looks almost the same as when you placed it, your space is light. The energy is flowing as it should. In any case, never touch the lemon with your hands afterward. Wrap it in paper, throw it away outside, and wash the plate with running water. It did its job. If on the first night, the lemon darkens repeat for seven nights in a row. Replace the lemon every morning. You will notice that each day it wakes up a little clearer. That means the environment is being cleaned gradually. And along with that, pay attention to your sleep, your dreams, how you feel when you wake up. Many people say they stop having nightmares, wake up lighter, and feel the room is different. Write in the comments, I will do it tonight, if you are going to try this, and come back to tell me what happened to the lemon. And if you feel that it is not just the space around you that needs cleansing, but everything you carry inside, the weight that keeps you up at night, the stress that never leaves, the emotions nobody taught you how to release. I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that. And everything I know is inside the Way Back to Stillness. The link is in my profile.
